text: INTERPRETER (run/session/goal/test): a new operator ceiling, `--ceiling FILE` or `AXON_CEILING=FILE` (`axon-ceiling/1` JSON, every key required). When set it narrows AXON_ALLOWED_EFFECTS, AXON_ALLOWED_FS_READ/WRITE, AXON_ALLOWED_NET, AXON_BUDGET_TOKENS and AXON_MAX_DEPTH (narrower wins), records its sha256 in run_start, and turns R45 (--require-contained) on; a bad file is E1007 exit 2 before program code runs. NATIVE: `axon build` refuses AXON_CEILING (E0910) and a native binary under it exits 2. A run with no ceiling is unchanged: no pass/fail of any tracked program changes unless AXON_CEILING is set.
